modals.ventoy_core_body:
Ventoy is the foundational multi-boot engine of Savin HollowDrive. It transforms any USB drive into an automated multi-boot device.

During setup, Ventoy creates two partitions:
1. Main Partition (HOLLOWDRIVE / exFAT): Where your ISOs, OS images, and folders are stored.
2. Hidden Boot Partition (VTOYEFI): Houses the EFI and GRUB bootloaders.
modals.motor_body:
HollowDrive provides two technologies to decompress packages onto your USB:

1. Async Engine (RAM / Streaming - Recommended):
Pipes archives directly through RAM into 7-Zip without creating intermediate temporary files on your SSD/hard drive. Delivers maximum speed.

2. Classic Engine (Local Disk):
Downloads to a hidden folder on your SSD/HDD first before extracting to USB.
modals.legal_body:
Savin Super USB DOES NOT INCLUDE ROMS or copyrighted game files.

The end user is solely responsible for lawful usage of images and files added to the drive.
modals.pack_hollow_body:
This pack injects a selection of bootable rescue environments and utilities ready to use from the main menu:

• Advanced disk partitioning and management tools.
• Disk cloning, backup, and recovery utilities.
• Windows Live (WinPE) environments to repair broken systems.

And much more...
modals.batocera_body:
Batocera is an emulation operating system that can convert any computer into a video game console.

🛡️ DATA SAFETY:
Even when booting Batocera, you will NEVER lose the computer's existing data.
modals.cachyos_body:
I have prepared a custom version of CachyOS (Arch Linux) designed specifically to be fast and easy to use.

⚡ MAIN FEATURES:
• Universal: Works on almost any modern PC.
• Performance: Optimized to get the most out of your hardware.
• Portable: Take your OS, files, and apps with you anywhere.
modals.kde_body: Perfect for users who want something familiar like Windows. It is the easiest desktop environment to start with, although slightly larger than Hyprland.
modals.hyprland_body: One of the most beautiful and fluid Linux desktops. Ideal for maximum productivity, consumes minimal resources, and offers complete system control.
modals.savin_core_body: Savin HollowDrive is an all-in-one storage engineering suite engineered to simplify the creation and maintenance of versatile, high-speed multi-boot USB drives.
modals.ht_isos_body: This feature lets you drag or pick bootable ISO files to copy them directly and at maximum throughput to the Ventoy boot partition of your HollowDrive.
modals.ht_packs_body: Inject or update Batocera emulation assets or HollowDrive tool packages directly onto an existing drive without reformatting or losing your files.
modals.ht_cachy_body: Allows you to add, reinstall, or non-destructively remove the CachyOS system partition on your existing HollowDrive.

bato_modal_body:
Batocera is a retrogaming emulation system that turns any PC into a gaming console.

DATA SAFETY:
Running Batocera from USB will NEVER modify or touch your host PC's internal hard drive.

• Requires no installation on host
• Built-in drivers for Bluetooth and USB gamepads
• Saves all gameplay directly onto your HollowDrive
sys_modal_body:
I have prepared a system designed to be smooth and easy to use directly from USB.

MAIN FEATURES:
. Universal: Runs on almost any PC (x86_64).
. Portable: Keep your operating system, files, and applications always with you on the USB.
sys_modal_note: Each system has its advantages. Currently only CachyOS with Hyprland is available; if this project receives support I'll add more options ;>
